What combination uniquely identifies a row in mechanical_product_song_v, given that mechanical_product_song_id is required but not unique? Working guidance: Do not deduplicate using mechanical_product_song_id alone. Retain source rows as exposed by the current-record filter until the composite grain is confirmed.

Can the same Tempo Song appear multiple times on the same Mechanical Product, and how should repeats, medleys, alternate versions, hidden tracks, and bonus tracks be distinguished? Working guidance: Treat each current source row as a distinct product-song record and use song_id + song_sequence_id only for Song identity, not row uniqueness.

Provide the governed allowed values, business meanings, lifecycle order, and terminal statuses for license_status_id. Working guidance: Retain the source ID without inferred groupings until a governed domain is supplied.

Provide the governed Licensing Rate Type values and explain how each type determines or changes rate calculations. Working guidance: Analyze rate amounts only within the same licensing_rate_type_id and currency_cd; do not compare or aggregate across types.
Define CR in total_cr_on_product, including unit, calculation, and eligible product-song population. Working guidance: Expose as a stored source value only; exclude from certified KPIs until defined.

Confirm the unit and calculation for total_duration_on_product and whether it includes all tracks, licensed tracks, repeats, hidden tracks, and bonus tracks. Working guidance: Treat as a stored source measure; do not recompute from duration_tx until inclusion and duration-format rules are approved.
Define SAMP/SMP in total_samp_tracks and specify the track eligibility and distinct-count methodology. Working guidance: Use the stored product value; do not derive it by counting child rows.

Confirm valid ranges, null and zero meaning, weighting, denominators, and product roll-up rules for controlled and collectable percentages. Working guidance: Do not sum percentages. Keep product and product-song percentages at their native grains; use unweighted averages only as provisional descriptive metrics.

Document formulas, evaluation order, units, and contractual inputs for base, reduction, controlled, and collectable rate amounts. Working guidance: Treat all fields as stored source values. Aggregate only by common currency and Licensing Rate Type after additivity is confirmed.

Confirm whether currency_cd applies consistently to every monetary field on each object and identify any fields stored in a fixed or implied currency. Working guidance: Never aggregate monetary fields across currency_cd. Flag populated monetary values with missing currency.

Define the contractual meaning of advance amount and advance units at product and product-song grains, including whether child advances allocate or duplicate product-level advances. Working guidance: Report product and product-song advances separately; do not combine them.

Confirm whether units_sold_qt is period activity or a cumulative snapshot and define the event or as-of meaning of units_sold_dt. Working guidance: Do not sum repeated observations for a product until snapshot behavior is confirmed.

Define the exact business event or as-of point represented by ltd_units_sold_dt and confirm snapshot selection rules. Working guidance: LTD means License to Date. Use only the latest appropriate snapshot per mechanical_product_id.

Expand AGC and document the definition, unit, formula, grain, and aggregation method for ltd_total_song_agc. Working guidance: Retain as an uncategorized stored source measure and exclude from certified KPIs.

Document the formula, currency or unit, song weighting, duration treatment, and additivity of the License-to-Date total pro rata mechanical rate. Working guidance: Do not sum or average across products until the approved calculation and weighting are documented.

Define set-to-pay, numerator, denominator, eligibility, workflow stage, valid range, and null meaning for ltd_set_to_pay_pc. Working guidance: Treat as a stored percentage; do not aggregate or set thresholds.

Define the licensed population, denominator, valid range, and relationship to controlled, collectable, and set-to-pay percentages. Working guidance: Treat as a stored percentage at product grain; do not infer completion rules.

Document the calculation for total_est_collect_am, including units, rates, controlled and collectable percentages, advances, gross/net treatment, and currency. Working guidance: Treat as a stored source estimate and aggregate only within currency; label as provisional.

Provide allowed values, null meaning, positive-match logic, matching grain, and refresh behavior for income_matched. Working guidance: Do not classify positive or negative matches until the domain is approved.
Define allowed values, positive-state logic, and distinction from product-level income_matched. Working guidance: Treat as an unresolved indicator and do not derive match rates.

Confirm that SL means Statement Line; define allowed values, match grain, whether one product-song can match multiple Statement Lines, and downstream effect. Working guidance: Treat as an unresolved indicator; do not count matched records until positive-state logic is approved.

Define each workflow event, responsible party, expected sequence, exception handling, and whether turnaround uses calendar or business days. Working guidance: Provisional turnaround is issued_dt minus request_dt for nonnegative intervals; received_dt is not used until its event is confirmed.

Define the process that sets first_income_expected_dt, refresh rules, relationship to release_dt, and what constitutes overdue income. Working guidance: Use only as a planning date; do not infer actual receipt or overdue status.

Define how times_on_product_qt is determined and how repeats, medleys, alternate versions, hidden tracks, and bonus tracks are counted. Working guidance: Use the stored value without deriving distinct-song counts from it.

Confirm the storage format, unit, parsing rules, and whether duration affects statutory or pro rata mechanical-rate calculations. Working guidance: Treat as text and do not convert or calculate without an approved format rule.

Provide allowed values, null meaning, and explain whether each indicator changes rates, eligibility, counts, or licensing treatment. Working guidance: Do not infer Y/N or apply business rules until domains are confirmed.
Define the exact contractual provision represented, allowed values, scope, and consequences for rate calculation. Working guidance: Treat as an unresolved indicator; do not derive rate adjustments.

Identify the entity referenced by cover_id and explain its role in version classification, licensing, and rate determination. Working guidance: Retain as an opaque source identifier until its reference entity is documented.

Define the product-level and product-song-level meanings of track_income_ind and whether the two fields use the same domain. Working guidance: Keep object-specific interpretations separate and do not assume equivalence.

Define the relationship, precedence, uniqueness, and cross-system roles of Product Number, Primary Product Number, and Mechanical Product Release ID. Working guidance: Use mechanical_product_id as the authoritative product key. Treat other identifiers as attributes until governance is confirmed.

Define the relationship, uniqueness, and operational roles of License Number and Tempo License ID at product and product-song levels. Working guidance: Do not treat either identifier as a certified unique license key until confirmed.

Confirm format, normalization, uniqueness, leading-zero handling, and issuing-system rules for external identifiers. Working guidance: Preserve source strings and leading zeros; use as matching attributes rather than standalone keys.

Are orphan current product-song source rows permitted when the LEFT JOIN to the parent Mechanical Product does not resolve? Working guidance: Retain orphan rows because the view uses a LEFT JOIN; monitor and report them as unresolved parent relationships.

Confirm whether populated lookup identifiers with null descriptive names are allowable historical conditions or data defects requiring remediation. Working guidance: Retain the core row and flag unresolved descriptive lookups for monitoring.

Confirm that the intended row grain is the complete non-measure GROUP BY set (office/currency, Client/Deal/CTC, Song, Source hierarchy, income classifications, accounting/statement periods, streaming, A&R, transaction category, hold status, signing-year bucket, AKA names, and company group), rather than simply Client + Song.
